Staind ( STAYND)  is an American rock band from Springfield, Massachusetts, formed in 1995.
The original lineup consisted of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Aaron Lewis, lead guitarist Mike Mushok, bassist and backing vocalist Johnny April, and drummer Jon Wysocki.
The lineup has been stable outside of the 2011 departure of Wysocki, who was replaced by Sal Giancarelli.
